name: reflected-crc32-refused
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.27 (a CRC-32 checksum on the tlv wire) with Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): The checksum value 9dd7ed43 is the reflected CRC-32 of zlib and Python binascii.crc32 over the covered bytes; the CRC of 0.27 of those bytes is 16b0fb85, so the value differs and the input is malformed-wire. CRC-32 of ISO/IEC 13818-1 (poly 04c11db7, init ffffffff, MSB first, no reflection, no final XOR) over the key through the checksum item's tag and length (ruling 1 of 0.27). Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program, checked against the check values 123456789 -> 0376e6e7 and empty -> ffffffff.
